tasks.title: Pin runtime expectations and artifact hygiene
tasks.dod: Runtime and generated artifact rules are explicit and consistent across package metadata, README, and ignore rules.

tasks.title: Extract an explicit TypeScript typecheck gate
tasks.dod: `npm run typecheck` performs strict TypeScript checking without emitting files, and build still checks types before bundling.

tasks.title: Add a focused ESLint gate
tasks.dod: `npm run lint` checks the configured source and test files with committed ESLint configuration and actionable failures.

tasks.title: Add the Vitest deterministic test runner
tasks.dod: `npm run test:unit` can execute TypeScript unit tests without launching the browser game or React Three Fiber.

tasks.title: Seed focused deterministic coverage
tasks.dod: At least one isolated utility or game-rule test passes through `npm run test:unit` and can guide future focused tests.

tasks.title: Compose the aggregate deterministic verify command
tasks.dod: `npm run verify` runs typecheck, lint, unit tests, and build in a clear deterministic order while leaving `test:e2e` available.

tasks.title: Add pull-request verification workflow
tasks.dod: Pull requests run `npm ci` and `npm run verify` through a committed GitHub Actions workflow with visible pass/fail status.

tasks.title: Document setup, gate order, and completion rules
tasks.dod: Contributor docs agree on setup, gate purpose, failure ownership, PR verification, and Playwright completion coverage.
